title: Template-Based Productivity
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting template-based productivity to reusable spreadsheet template with formulas, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Replace hand-typed totals with formulas (`=SUM`) so values recalculate when inputs change.
Distinguish relative references (`B2`) from absolute references (`$C$1`) and predict how each behaves when copied.
Keep a blank master template separate from each filled-in working copy.
Justify a template by the recurring task it eliminates, not by how the document looks.
